segments.t: Masters, give to your servants that which is just and equal, knowing that you also have a Master in heaven.
segments.note: 語順の組み替え（τὸ δίκαιον καὶ τὴν ἰσότητα τοῖς δούλοις παρέχεσθε）

segments.t: Continue steadfastly in prayer, watching in it with thanksgiving,
praying together for us also, that God may open to us a door for the word, to speak the mystery of Christ, for which I am also in bonds,
that I may reveal it as I ought to speak.
Walk in wisdom toward those who are outside, redeeming the time.
segments.note: τοὺς ἔξω を「those who are outside」とほぐす

segments.t: Let your speech always be with grace, seasoned with salt, that you may know how you ought to answer each one.
segments.note: 繋辞の「be」は英語の補い（ὁ λόγος ὑμῶν πάντοτε ἐν χάριτι）

segments.t: All my affairs will be made known to you by Tychicus, the beloved brother, faithful servant, and fellow bondservant in the Lord.
segments.note: 語順の組み替え（Τὰ κατ᾽ ἐμὲ πάντα γνωρίσει ὑμῖν Τυχικὸς を受動態にほぐす）

segments.t: I am sending him to you for this very purpose, that he may know your circumstances and comfort your hearts,
segments.note: ギリシャ語本文は ἵνα γνῶτε τὰ περὶ ἡμῶν（あなたがたが私たちの様子を知る）だが WEB は異本（γνῷ τὰ περὶ ὑμῶν）に従い「he may know your circumstances」とする

segments.t: together with Onesimus, the faithful and beloved brother, who is one of you. They will make known to you everything that is going on here.
segments.note: τὰ ὧδε を「everything that is going on here」とほぐす

segments.t: Aristarchus, my fellow prisoner, greets you, and Mark the cousin of Barnabas (concerning whom you received instructions, “if he comes to you, receive him”),
and Jesus who is called Justus. These are my only fellow workers for God’s Kingdom who are of the circumcision, men who have been a comfort to me.
segments.note: 語順のほぐし（οἱ ὄντες ἐκ περιτομῆς、οὗτοι μόνοι συνεργοί ...）

segments.t: Epaphras, who is one of you, a servant of Christ, salutes you, always striving for you in his prayers, that you may stand perfect and complete in all the will of God.
segments.note: πεπληροφορημένοι を「complete」と訳す。「his」は英語の補い

segments.t: For I testify about him that he has great zeal for you, and for those in Laodicea, and for those in Hierapolis.
segments.note: πολὺν πόνον を WEB は「great zeal」と訳す

segments.t: Luke the beloved physician and Demas greet you.
segments.note: 語順の組み替え（ἀσπάζεται ὑμᾶς Λουκᾶς ...）

segments.t: Greet the brothers who are in Laodicea, with Nymphas and the assembly that is in his house.
segments.note: ギリシャ語本文は Νύμφαν・αὐτῆς（女性・彼女の）だが WEB は「Nymphas ... his」とする（男性名として扱う異本系）

segments.t: When this letter has been read among you, cause it to be read also in the assembly of the Laodiceans, and that you also read the letter from Laodicea.
Tell Archippus, “Take heed to the ministry which you have received in the Lord, that you fulfill it.”
I, Paul, write this greeting with my own hand. Remember my chains. Grace be with you.
segments.note: 語順の組み替え（Ὁ ἀσπασμὸς τῇ ἐμῇ χειρὶ Παύλου）
WEB はビザンティン本文に従い「Amen」を補う。ギリシャ語本文にこの語はない
